constraint_fidelity.evidence: The diff follows every operator answer. It trims input and treats blank as empty (product_cleaner.py: "(cleaned_input[\"storage_conditions\"] or \"\").strip() or None"). It enforces the 250 limit in the column, the API and the dashboard input (ProductDetailsForm.tsx: "maxLength={STORAGE_CONDITIONS_MAX_LENGTH}"). The dashboard field sits under the description in General Information. It adds the webhook field (payloads.py: "+    \"storage_conditions\",") and the CSV export field (enums.py: "STORAGE_CONDITIONS = \"storage conditions\""), and leaves import out. There is a short CHANGELOG entry and no ADR. The storefront shows a separate labelled block after the description and hides it when empty (storage-conditions.tsx: "Labelled \"Storage conditions\" block shown after the description. Renders nothing when empty."). Translation falls back to the base value (storefront-view.ts: "pickTranslatedField(product.translation, \"storageConditions\", product.storageConditions)"). The extras are small and fit the feature: productBulkCreate/productBulkTranslate support, a dashboard .changeset, and a CONTEXT.md glossary term ("## Product content ... **Storage conditions**"). One minor point: the dashboard translation input has no client-side 250 cap (translationSectionBuilders.ts adds a SHORT field without maxLength). The API still enforces the limit, which arguably satisfies "translation same limit".
